instruction: Please open and start playing the Rick Astley music video file located on the desktop using VLC media player.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.explanation: Task variation that paraphrases the original instruction. Uses the same evaluator to check if VLC is playing the specified video file. The evaluator verifies the playing state and filename match in VLC's status XML.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: VLC is playing (checks state=='playing') and the correct file is loaded (verifies filename match)
Getter get_vlc_playing_info properly extracts VLC status via HTTP interface to status.xml
Metric is_vlc_playing correctly parses XML, checks playing state, and compares filename using multiple robust comparison methods (exact match, endswith, contains)
Expected filename 'Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4' matches the downloaded file path in config
Metric parameter handling is correct: receives rules dict directly as second parameter (not wrapped), aligns with framework's get_rule() behavior
Complete semantic coverage: instruction requires opening VLC + playing + specific file, all verified by evaluator
